sections.Aims and Fit of Module: To provide a basic understanding of the principles of Real Analysis.
sections.Learning outcomes: A. State definitions and theorems in real analysis. B. Present proofs of the main theorems. C. Apply these definitions and theorems to simple examples. D. Construct their own proofs of simple unseen results.
sections.Method of teaching and learning: This module will be delivered by a combination of formal lectures and tutorials.
